contact.department: Fairfax County GIS Division (Department of Information Technology)

counties.notes: Fairfax County (Northern Virginia, pop. 1.15 million) is the most populous jurisdiction in Virginia and covers 406 square miles, entirely distinct from Fairfax City -- a separate independent city (FIPS 51600) that sits geographically within the county but is governed and assessed independently. The county-direct parcel layer at fairfaxcounty.gov/mercator/rest/services/OpenData/OpenData_A9/MapServer/0 exposes PIN, PARCEL_KEY, PARCEL_TYPE (ORDINARY vs. CONDO), and SRC_CONTROL -- but no owner name. Fairfax keeps ownership data in a non-spatial table not exposed on this REST endpoint. For owner-name lookup, use the Fairfax County Real Estate Assessment Database at realestate.fairfaxcounty.gov; it supports search by address, parcel ID, and owner name. The GIS/Property MapServer at fairfaxcounty.gov/euclid/rest has 54 layers (parcels, tax districts, easements, flood zones, annotations) but also does not surface owner in the queryable parcel layer. PIN format is space-padded with section/block/lot grouping (e.g., '0304 39  0029'). Verified 2026-05-11: 369,267 polygon parcels. Updated daily from county cadastral.

Prince William County (Northern Virginia, pop. ~490,000; county seat unincorporated, courts in Manassas) publishes an Open Data parcel MapServer at gisweb.pwcva.gov (note the host is gisweb.pwcva.gov, NOT pwcgov.org). Layer 0 exposes 49 fields and -- unlike neighboring Fairfax County -- includes owner name directly: CAMA_OWNER_CUR (current owner from the CAMA system) and CAMA_DEEDOWNER (deed owner). Parcel identifier is GPIN, a hyphenated geographic id (e.g. '7201-09-8851'). Site address is split across ST_NO / ST_NAME / ST_TYPE / CITY / ZIP. Verified 2026-06-20: 159,174 parcels; UPPER(CAMA_OWNER_CUR) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real owners with Haymarket/Manassas-area addresses and ZIPs. IMPORTANT: this entry covers Prince William COUNTY only. The independent cities of Manassas (FIPS 51683) and Manassas Park (FIPS 51685) sit within the county's geographic bounds but are separate Census FIPS jurisdictions, governed and assessed independently. For authoritative assessment records use the PWC Real Estate Assessments office. LIVENESS 2026-08-04: answers a home-network probe in ~2.6s with 10 correct parcel rows, but exceeds even the raised 15s host budget from the Vercel probe region on 112 consecutive checks. That pattern reads as datacenter-IP throttling rather than a slow server, so raising the budget further would risk the 60s shard ceiling for no gain. Stays honestly degraded.

counties.notes: Chesterfield County, Virginia (FIPS 51041) publishes its parcels on its own ArcGIS Online organisation as Cadastral_ProdA, FeatureServer layer 3 'ParcelsEnriched': 150,624 parcels, 150,470 of them with an owner, on 2026-10-08. The owner is OwnerName (for example SMITH KENDLE M JR & SUSAN K); the situs is Address (24321 PEAR ORCHARD RD); the owner mailing address is OwnerAddress plus OwnerCity/OwnerState/OwnerZip (the street line can be PO BOX style, written '40 PO BOX'); the parcel key is Name, a 15-digit text value (671662189900000), with TaxID the same key as an integer and GPIN the 10-digit Virginia number (6716621899). The layer answers any Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, has maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination, and is edited daily (editingInfo dataLastEditDate 2026-10-08; AssessmentYear 2026 on every populated row). 161 rows have no AssessmentYear and 154 no owner, probably right-of-way slivers. TRAP: the county's older Hub item 'Parcels' (Cadastral/FeatureServer/3) is flagged deprecated, holds 146,864 features and has been frozen since 2024-07-30 (AssessmentYear 2024); do not use it. The service name 'ProdA' suggests the county may rotate to a ProdB: if this URL returns 404, re-resolve the current parcel layer from the county Hub. The statewide VGIN parcel layer (VA_Parcels) carries no owner field for any jurisdiction, so it is not a fallback. The licenseUrl is the ArcGIS Online item for this service (Cadastral_ProdA, public); its licenseInfo field is empty, so no terms are published for it. Verified 2026-10-08: owner SMITH returned rows (first SMITH KENDLE M JR & SUSAN K, 671662189900000, 24321 PEAR ORCHARD RD, Moseley); a situs query for 9901 LORI RD returned COUNTY OF CHESTERFIELD (TaxID 771662232700000); a point query at -77.5043,37.3773 returned COUNTY OF CHESTERFIELD, 6900 MIMMS DR.

contact.department: City of Newport News Planning (Maps and Data; GIS questions), (757) 926-8761

counties.notes: The City of Newport News, Virginia (FIPS 51700) is an independent city that belongs to no county. Its Planning department's Operational/Parcel MapServer layer 0 holds 54,444 parcels, 54,359 of them with an owner, on 2026-10-08. The owner is OWNERNME1 (SMITH BRECK J) with OWNERNME2; the situs is SITEADDRESS (914 19TH ST); the owner mailing address is PSTLADDRESS1/PSTLADDRESS2 plus PSTLCITY, PSTLSTATE and PSTLZIP5; the parcel id is PARCELID, nine digits of text (313000441). CORS: the server echoes the request Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin and sends no CORS header at all when no Origin is sent, so a probe without an Origin header will wrongly read it as closed. maxRecordCount is 2000 with pagination. CURRENCY IS NOT PUBLISHED: the layer has no editingInfo, LASTUPDATE is null on the sampled rows, the city says only that it is 'updated as necessary', the Hub item was modified 2026-09-11 and last-sale dates include 2025; treat owners as possibly a few months behind. The licenseUrl is the city GeoHub item, whose licenseInfo says the data is public information with no warranties and not for legal, engineering or survey use. The statewide VGIN layer (54,438 rows for this FIPS) has no owner field and is not a fallback. No GIS email address was found; the city's Maps and Data page gives the Planning department's phone. Verified 2026-10-08: owner SMITH returned rows (first SMITH BRECK J, 313000441, 914 19TH ST); a situs query for 2400 WASHINGTON AVE returned CITY OF NEWPORT NEWS (315010302); a point query at -76.4730,37.0871 returned CITY OF NEWPORT NEWS, 725 TOWN CENTER DR.

James City County, Virginia (Williamsburg area; FIPS 51095) was asked for through the free tools. The county publishes its parcels on its own ArcGIS Server at property.jamescitycountyva.gov, JCC/GIS_Data FeatureServer layer 17 ('Parcels', one row per parcel): 36,478 parcels on 2026-10-10, 36,364 of them with an owner. The owner is Owner1 with Owner2; the situs is Full_Address (also split as ADDR_NUM plus Street_Name, and repeated from the assessment record as LocAddr/LocCity/LocZip) with City and Zip_Code; the owner mailing address is MailAddr plus MailCity, MailStat and MailZip (MailZip is nine digits without a hyphen); the parcel id is PIN, ten digits of text, alongside UID and the LRSN. The layer also carries the last three sales with grantors, three years of land, improvement and total assessed values, zoning, the state property class and legal acres. CORS: the server echoes the request Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so a probe without an Origin header reads it as closed. maxRecordCount is 2000 with pagination. The service lists Update and Editing capabilities alongside Query; the atlas only ever reads. The county also mirrors this layer to an ArcGIS Online hosted service that answers 'Token Required' (499) to anonymous requests; it is not used. Currency: the ArcGIS Online item for this layer was modified 2026-10-08 and the rows carry current-year assessed values. TERMS: the item's license text says the data is believed to be correct but is not guaranteed by James City County, that the county is not responsible for its accuracy or currency, that discrepancies go to the county GIS department, and that 'disclaimers as to such should be placed on all final products derived from the provided data'. Anything built from this record should carry that disclaimer. Field definitions: property.jamescitycountyva.gov/AGOL/Documents/AGOL_Open_Data/Parcel_Fields.pdf. No GIS email address is published; the county's GIS / Mapping page is the contact. Verified 2026-10-10: a count, resultRecordCount=1, an owner LIKE query (341 rows for %SMITH%) and a situs LIKE query on MAIN ST (9 rows).

contact.department: City of Salem, Virginia GIS (published on ArcGIS Online as SalemVA_GIS)

counties.notes: Salem, Virginia (an independent city, county-equivalent FIPS 51775). The city publishes its tax parcels itself on ArcGIS Online (organisation SalemVA_GIS) as TaxParcels FeatureServer layer 5 (the service has a single layer, id 5, described 'City of Salem, Virginia tax parcel layer'): 10,765 parcels on 2026-10-14, 10,681 of them with an owner. The owner is owner (varchar 1000); the previous owner is prev_owner. The situs is FullAddress (10,681 rows; also split into street_number, street_name and street_suffix, with zip_code). The parcel id is GPIN (a 14-character string such as 0633-03-384633, on all 10,765 rows), with tax_map_number as the city's tax map id (10,681 rows). MAILING ADDRESS: owner_address2 is the street line (10,680 rows; it equals the situs on 6,533 rows, the owner-occupied parcels; 809 are PO boxes), owner_city_state and owner_zip complete it, and owner_address1 is a care-of line populated on only 803 rows (791 start with C/O), so it is not the primary street line. Currency: Last_Rundate peaks at 2026-10-13, the day before verification, and date_of_transfer reaches 2025-06 on sampled rows; the service's dataLastEditDate is also 2026-10-13. CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is '*' (ArcGIS Online hosted service). maxRecordCount is 2000 with pagination; the layer wkid is 102747 (Virginia South State Plane, US feet) so a lon/lat point query takes inSR=4326 and works. No license text is published on the layer. Verified 2026-10-14: owner LIKE %SMITH% returned 103 rows (10 with resultRecordCount=10), situs LIKE %MAIN ST% 353 rows, and a point query at the Census internal point -80.05524,37.28533 returned one parcel on S Market St with zip 24153. The city's other ArcGIS Online items (an exempt-parcels map and a dashboard) and a WFS copy of the same parcels are not registered.

contact.department: Loudoun County Office of Mapping and Geographic Information, (703) 771-5778

counties.notes: Loudoun County, Virginia (FIPS 51107). The county's public parcel layers on logis.loudoun.gov (LMIS_ParcelsPlatfile, 132,900 parcels on 2026-11-01; LandRecords Parcel Boundaries; Parcels4DIT) and on its ArcGIS Online organisation (Loudoun Parcels System Links, 132,940 parcels) carry parcel keys, street addresses and subdivision fields only, with no owner name or mailing address. Owner names are shown one parcel at a time on the Commissioner of the Revenue's Real Estate Information Site, which can be searched by parcel ID, address or tax map number but not by owner name and has no query service. For parcel and owner records, use that site or contact the Commissioner of the Revenue, realestate@loudoun.gov, (703) 777-0260.

coverage.summary: Loudoun County's public parcel layers have parcel keys, street and subdivision fields but no owner names or mailing addresses, so we don't index it. The Commissioner of the Revenue's property search shows owners one parcel at a time. Request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: Stafford County, Virginia (FIPS 51179; county seat Stafford) publishes the parcel layer its public County Map Viewer searches on the County GIS Office's own ArcGIS Server: WebApp/WebApp_Parcels MapServer layer 0, "Parcels" (ArcGIS 10.91, Map,Query,Data), 61,280 rows on 2026-10-25, 61,096 of them with an owner. The owner is Owner1; the owner mailing address is Own_Street, Own_City, Own_State and Own_Zip; the situs is FULLADD; the parcel number is PARCEL_ID_NSP, the id without spaces (for example 29D826), which is what the viewer's own parcel search uses. PRCLID is the same id space-padded and is listed only as a reference. TotVal1 is the populated assessed total; TotVal2 and TotVal3 are empty. The layer answers any Origin with an Access-Control-Allow-Origin header that reflects it, has maxRecordCount 1000 with pagination, and uses a Virginia North feet coordinate system, so a point query must set inSR=4326 (a point near the courthouse returned one parcel). No placeholder for a withheld owner appears in the layer. Currency: the newest Sale1D is 08/27/2026 (text, MM/DD/YYYY), but the geometry stamps stop at 2024-10-17 and Assmnt1D is empty on every row, so treat sale and assessment columns as the county's and verify with the Stafford County Commissioner of the Revenue. The sampleQuery returns 10 rows and the layer reports more (exceededTransferLimit). TRAP: the county's open-data Hub also lists a Parcels FeatureServer (services1.arcgis.com/qKiA6JuCrE2l72iL), current and open to any origin, but it has no owner or mailing columns; it is only an owner-less fallback. The same MapServer is also served on the viewer's front host, gismapping.stafford.va.us, if portal-gis moves. The statewide VGIN layer has no owner or address columns. No licence, copyright text or use condition is published on the layer, the service, the viewer's web map or the county GIS page; the page carries only a no-warranty, not-a-legal-description disclaimer, and the county's GIS FAQ says its GIS information is available to the public, so the licence is recorded as unknown, as for Chesterfield and Salem. Informational only and not a legal description.

contact.department: Isle of Wight County GIS Department, (757) 365-6278

counties.notes: Isle of Wight County, Virginia (FIPS 51093; county seat Isle of Wight) publishes its parcel layer on the county GIS Department's ArcGIS Online organisation as IOW_Parcels, FeatureServer layer 0, the layer its public Parcel Viewer (the county website's Online Property Map) searches. It held 22,276 rows on 2026-11-01, 22,124 of them with an owner. The owner is NAME1 with a second owner in NAME2; the owner mailing address is ADDRESS1, CITY, STATE and ZIP; the situs is ParclAddre (abbreviated street form; the sister column ParcelAddr spells the street out but carries the placeholders No Addressed Structures or Multiple Addresses on 6,070 rows); the parcel number is TPIN (for example 06-01-001C), which is what the viewer searches. TOT_VAL is the assessed total and Sale_date the last sale date. The layer answers any Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Origin *, has maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination, and is in Web Mercator, so a point query must set inSR=4326 (a point at the courthouse complex returned one parcel). No placeholder for a withheld owner appears in the layer. Currency: the item says it is updated monthly (snippet Updated October 2026); the layer's data was last edited 2026-10-09, the newest CHGDATE is 2026-10-09 and the newest Sale_date is 2026-10-02. The same parcels are offered as a free shapefile download (item IOW_Parcels) in the county's GIS Open Data Site gallery. The only use term published on the layer, the shapefile, the viewer and the county's GIS Data Requests page is a Data Distribution Liability Statement that disclaims warranties and fitness for a particular purpose; there is no licence, fee for the open layers, commercial-use or redistribution term, so the licence is recorded as unknown, as for Chesterfield, Salem and Stafford. The statewide VGIN layer has no owner or address columns. Informational only and not a legal description; verify with the Isle of Wight County Commissioner of the Revenue.

No public REST parcel layer with owner names or site addresses was found for Henry County, Virginia (FIPS 51089; county offices in Collinsville) as of 2026-11-01. The county's GIS Maps page sends visitors to Henry County Interactive GIS (henrycova.interactivegis.com), a hosted InteractiveGIS site that opens only after a visitor clicks I ACCEPT, ticks a terms box and posts a guest form, and that has no ArcGIS REST directory (the /arcgis/rest/services path returns HTTP 404); its sign-in page says the data was updated on 10/13/2026. Searches of ArcGIS Online found two Henry County, Virginia parcel items, neither published by the county: one held by a third-party organisation answers 'Token Required', and one held by a software vendor's account (Henry_Va, 11,185 rows, last edited 2023-09-21) is a partial, three-year-old copy. The other Henry County hits belong to other states' Henry Counties; none returned a parcel near Collinsville. The same search shape for Isle of Wight County finds that county's own public parcel service, so the absence is meaningful. The statewide VGIN parcel layer holds 54,273 Henry parcels last updated 2026-05-07, but carries only a parcel id and tax map id with no owner, situs or mailing columns, so it is not used. The City of Martinsville, an independent city inside the county, keeps its own GIS and is not part of this record. This record answers a request for the county on 2026-10-27. Parcel and owner records are available through the county's Interactive GIS, or from the Henry County Commissioner of the Revenue.

coverage.summary: Henry County publishes parcels only through its Interactive GIS map, which has no query service, and Virginia's statewide layer has no owner names or addresses, so we don't index it. Use the county's map, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.
